newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-S&P assigns A-minus to Latrobe hospital bonds.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-S&P assigns A-minus to Latrobe hospital bonds.

text.p: Ratings agency Standard & Poor's said on Thursday it had assigned an 'A-minus' long-term credit rating to the A$40 million CPI indexed bonds to be issued by Latrobe Regional Hospital Pty Ltd (LRH).

S&P said the rating reflected LRH's exclusive rights to the provision of essential hospital and public health services in the Latrobe Valley, and strong structural protection of revenues for debt service.
It also reflected the appointment of an experienced operator, Australian Hospital Care (Latrobe) Pty Ltd, a fully owned subsidiary of Australian Hospital Care Ltd.
LRH is a special purpose vehicle which will own the New Latrobe Regional Hospital, to be built at East Morwell, about 150 kilometres east of Melbourne.
